notes: I built a first mechanism: insert "10" at a split point (after the first character, or after a comma if present), with case normalization (uppercase first letter of multi-char strings, lowercase the rest; single chars lowercased). The case rule is uncertain—`"A"→"10a"` vs `"ab"→"A10b"` is the main puzzle—so it's marked with `?` and needs more probes to pin down.
